answer: An adversary running 61 aliases therefore needs 102 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are logged in hollow, expire in echo, and saffron lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4690 identities would post 1154 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
